understandingEvidence.essentialUnderstandingDe: Salzbildung aus Elementen umfasst Elektronenübertragung und Ionenbildung sowie elektrostatische Gitterbildung. Die Gesamtenergiebilanz, einschließlich energieverbrauchender Vorbereitung, erklärt den exothermen Modellfall.
understandingEvidence.essentialUnderstandingEn: Salt formation from elements involves electron transfer and ion formation as well as electrostatic lattice formation. The full energy balance, including energy-consuming preparation, explains the exothermic model case.
understandingEvidence.observablePerformanceDe: Die lernende Person leitet Na+ und Cl− mit ihren Elektronenverteilungen ab und bilanziert im gegebenen Modell +108+122+496−349−787=−410 kJ/mol. Sie erklärt, weshalb die Edelgaskonfiguration allein und ein einzelner Ionisierungsschritt keine Wärmefreisetzung begründen.
understandingEvidence.observablePerformanceEn: The learner derives Na+ and Cl− with their electron distributions and balances the supplied model as +108+122+496−349−787=−410 kJ/mol, explaining why noble-gas configuration alone or one ionization step does not establish heat release.
understandingEvidence.transferExpectationDe: Im frischen Mg/O-Modell leitet sie den Zweielektronenübergang und das Ionenverhältnis 1:1 ab, bilanziert +3000−3600=−600 kJ/mol und trennt den Modellweg von einer Laborfolge, Spontaneität und Aktivierungsenergie.
understandingEvidence.transferExpectationEn: In the fresh Mg/O model, the learner derives two-electron transfer and a 1:1 ion ratio, balances +3000−3600=−600 kJ/mol, and distinguishes the model path from a laboratory sequence, spontaneity and activation energy.

rationale: Fresh independent targeted B review, sealed in own-four-d-and-c441-p.first-pass.json before any current peer judgment. KEEP whole DE/EN goal and new physical PDF page 3. Its related ion/electron configuration and energy aspects jointly explain the source-bound school-level salt-formation model and are supported by the three explicit prerequisites. Actual inspection shows an energy-consuming preparation to gaseous Na+/Cl− followed by a larger release on lattice formation and a lower product level; the bound alt text identifies a thermodynamic model, not a kinetic activation barrier. Both ions have the correct supplied closed-shell distributions. The full sentence and ID are readable; line-break hyphenation of Gitterenergie is normal. The image does not itself show every electron-transfer step or establish observed learner mastery. The two complete bilingual material cases supply those missing performances with correct −410 and illustrative −600 kJ/mol balances; this does not turn invented data into measured chemistry.
currentTitleEn: Explain salt formation energetically using lattice energy
currentDescriptionDe: Die lernende Person kann Salzbildung aus Elementen als Ionenbildung mit Elektronenübergang beschreiben, die Edelgaskonfiguration mithilfe des Energiestufenmodells begründen und den exothermen Verlauf über Gitterenergie als Triebkraft erklären.
currentDescriptionEn: The learner can describe salt formation from elements as ion formation through electron transfer, justify noble-gas configuration using the energy level model, and explain the exothermic course through lattice energy as the driving force.
